title: Liposonix vs Liposuction: What to Expect
h1: Liposonix vs liposuction: what to expect from each
desc: Liposonix vs liposuction: how much fat each removes, recovery, risks, results timeline and who each suits. A clear guide from Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: Liposuction surgically removes a large volume of fat through small incisions and needs anaesthesia and weeks of recovery. Liposonix uses focused ultrasound to destroy a smaller amount of stubborn fat in one non-invasive session, with no downtime and results over 8 to 12 weeks. Liposonix suits people near their goal weight; liposuction suits larger volumes.
body:
## How each works

Liposuction suctions fat out through a thin cannula. Liposonix directs focused ultrasound into the fat layer, destroying fat cells that the body clears naturally.

## Choosing

- A small, stubborn bulge and no wish for surgery: Liposonix
- Larger areas or significant volume: a surgical consultation
- Loose skin too: consider skin tightening alongside

## Keeping results

Both remove fat cells from the treated area, but remaining fat cells can still grow with weight gain. A steady lifestyle keeps the shape.
